title: eucryphia billardierei var. milliganii
intro: Eucryphia billardierei var. milliganii, commonly known as Mountain Silver, is a plant species native to Tasmania and southern Australia. It is used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Silver include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Eucryphia billardierei var. milliganii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
